title: Array element write inside a clocked process (mem(idx) <= data)
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: Mirrors P4's lifo_stack BRAM-style write: a process samples (we, addr, din) on rising clk and writes mem(to_integer(unsigned(addr))) <= din. After the write, addr is held at the same value so dout reads back the written byte. Tests indexed-LHS assignment inside a clocked process — used by every memory-like component (lifo_stack, register file, BRAM).
